name: signature-funnel
description: Builds a Trevor Otts Signature Funnel — the SACRED 12-section Hero copy system, per-section long-form image prompts sized to the model's own character budget (95 to 100 percent of its maximum, never below 80 percent), GHL media + funnel build, and a configurable 3/5/7-step funnel (Main -> Checkout -> Upsell-1 -> Downsell-1 -> Upsell-2 -> Downsell-2 -> Thank-You with accept/decline branching). Gates the sacred method with fail-closed deterministic provers: the intake gate, the 12-section copy contract (per-section char/word bands, six page profiles), the image-prompt two-floor gate (length and structure), and a no-pitch (clean thank-you) + image-provenance gate. A canonical fail-closed entry (deps/bypass-scan/hash-pin/0600-nonce) drives a no-skip orchestrator that issues a signed PROCESS-CERTIFICATE only on all-phases-pass. Delegates image generation to Skill 66 (model policy) then Skill 74 (the one approved KIE transport) and ALL GHL media + build to Skill 6. Client runtime uses the client's own providers, never Anthropic.

skill_number.source: directory name 49-signature-funnel; declared as a required launch-family tree by 83-black-friday-launcher/launcher_core/dependencies.json entry id tree-49-signature-funnel

pipeline_manifest.note: The phase spine (P0..P10), the _chk_sf_* preflight wrappers, the AF-FUN-* autofail codes and the delegation seams. It is the manifest of record for this skill's pipeline; this metadata file records identity and dependencies and never restates it.

depends_on.note: Names resolved from this skill's own code and manifests, not hand-picked: scripts/front_door.py _skill_dirs (the two shared-utils trees and the 83 launcher tree are hard requirements of the front-door gate) and FUNNEL-MANIFEST.json delegation_seams (the page, image-policy, image-transport and GHL-build owners). No skill.json in this repository lists Skill 49's requirement set, so this record is the only one; it conforms to the code it describes.
depends_on.pin_composition_note: scripts/front_door.py _skill_dirs refuses (ABORT [HASH-PIN]) when the Skill 83 launcher tree is absent, because the whole-tree pin composition covers it. That is a pin-input requirement, not a delegation of this skill's behaviour, so it is named separately from `required`.

provenance.reason: The published Skill 49 tree shipped without a root manifest. The file was absent from the source checkout, so the defect was repository-side and not a packaging exclusion: scripts/check-launch-family-parity.py copies every source file into the 999 tree, so it cannot drop a file the source does not have.
